name: SelectOption
description: Native option primitive for composing Select choices.

ariaRequirements: render only inside a native select
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-15 - native option semantics and disabled state verified through Select.

forbiddenUse: render SelectOption outside Select; browsers only expose option semantics inside a select
use an empty enabled option as a consequential default; disable placeholder options
dense: native option for Select; value and label required, children override label, optional disabled state

usage.description: SelectOption is the typed option primitive for Select children. Use it when declarative children are clearer than the options array, especially for placeholders and per-option attributes.

bestPractices.description: Use the Select options array for ordinary flat data; use SelectOption children for explicit declarative composition.
Disable an empty placeholder option so it cannot be reselected after a valid choice.
Do not render SelectOption outside Select; standalone option elements have no useful interaction semantics.
